response.sql: SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance), 0) AS attendance_share FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position ORDER BY attendance_share DESC, m.member_id LIMIT 10;
